{{Quote|You Korkie?''"<br />"''Prime Minister, is that you?''"<br />"''Secret Service, you are all under arrest for treason, corruption and conspiracy.|Cadet Korkie talking to this officer|<ref name="academy">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref>}}
This '''unidentified officer''' was a part of the [[Mandalorian secret service/Legends|Mandalorian Secret Service]] and a part of [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec's]] team of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were called to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to investigate a corruption case. Tano was given the task of looking into the matter, and with help from a few cadets from the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]] of Sundari, they discovered [[Almec/Legends|Almec's]] involvement in the black market conspiracy. This secret service officer was part of the team that Almec sent to arrest the cadets. He and his squad were later overpowered by Tano and retreated.
